text.text: See every deadline in one place. Log work as soon as it is announced, move it across the board, and enter the grade when it comes back.
These numbers update as you work. Use this page for the weekly check, then open the list behind any number to act on it.
Each chart groups your entries as shown; click a slice to see the entries behind it.
The lists below show only what needs attention now.
If a chart looks off, check that every entry is connected to the right person or item.
Work backwards from the exam day. Copy this plan into the exam row.

cells.text: Fix weak topics, make a one-page summary
List the topics; mark the weak ones
Past papers under time, then mark them
Summary sheets and weak topics only

text.text: Do one timed practice paper before the last week; it shows what to revise better than rereading.
Every Sunday, spend ten minutes on this list.
Open the board and move anything finished to Done.
Look at the calendar for the next seven days.
Pick the three assignments that most affect your grades.
Block study time for each in your calendar.
If something is due in the next 48 hours and still Not started, do that first.
Open the Overdue and Next 7 days lists above. If three items are due in one day, move your own deadline for two of them two days earlier.
